newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies six issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies six issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co said it has qualified for bond insurance the following six municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Mount Pleasant Comm., Iowa, $4.210 million school general obligation bonds.
--Urbandale Comm. School District, Iowa, $4.9 million school bonds and $3.81 million school refunding bonds.
--Bainbridge Island SD, Wash., $17 million unlimited tax bonds.
